default_reach.rule: no retroactive criminal liability; no general bar elsewhere
default_reach.meaning: an act applies from the day it takes effect; an act may give itself effect from an earlier day (an amending act says so: "har virkning fra ..."), except that no one is punished for an act that was not punishable by law when it was done
default_reach.authority: Kriminallov for Grønland (lov nr. 306 af 30. april 2008) § 1 (the legality principle) and Article 7 of the European Convention on Human Rights; Danmarks Riges Grundlov, which applies in Greenland, contains no general rule on retroactive legislation.
